narrative.overview: Every conversation is a production pass. Its colour band says who holds it and how urgent it is, at a glance, before any text is read. The world is an ink-black backstage rail beside pass-white paper: condensed bold caps for names and credential labels, plain-width Archivo for everything people actually read, flat fields of colour instead of badges, and state carried by marks rather than decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Ink rail beside pass-white panels on a cool wash page.
Magenta = tú and brand, cobalt = bot, signal orange = pending handoff, ink = another encargado.
Band width encodes urgency; the rotated condensed label names the holder.
State marks: outline at rest, filled when held, struck when resolved.
Condensed bold caps (Archivo wdth 62%) for names and labels; normal width for reading.
Flat: no shadows, small radii, violet-tinted hairlines.

rules.name: The Band Means Holder Rule
rules.body: Magenta, cobalt, signal and ink each mean exactly one holder. Never use a role colour decoratively, and never show a holder colour without its text label.

rules.name: The Signal Is Ink-Texted Rule
rules.body: Signal orange takes ink text. White on it fails contrast.

rules.name: The Magenta Text Rule
rules.body: Only #c9035c may be text; the bright magenta is for fills.

rules.name: The Caps Are Names Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps are for names and credential labels only.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Anything that counts or stamps time uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. Hover brightens a surface to white or darkens ink to ink-2; it does not cast.

dos: Do let a colour band plus its text label say who holds a conversation; width carries urgency.
Do use condensed caps (.ep-cond) only for client names, holder blocks and credential labels.
Do keep surfaces flat: hairlines, tonal fields, an inset ink ring for selection.
Do put ink text on signal orange and white text on magenta, cobalt and ink.
Do keep every touch target at least 44px, relaxing to 36-40px at lg.
Do use the mark grammar for state: outline at rest, filled when held, struck when resolved.
Do use --ep-* tokens on any new migrated surface and keep light theme only until a dark theme is designed.
donts: Don't add shadows, glows or gradient fills to panels, bubbles or buttons.
Don't show holder or status by colour alone.
Don't set body text, buttons or sentences in the condensed caps.
Don't mix legacy tokens (violet, zinc, Geist, --brand) with --ep-* on one surface; migrate the surface whole.
Don't replace the standing column band with stacked pill badges on rows.
Don't animate history: the entrance plays only for live incoming messages.
